messages:
Sasha (People Ops): @here quick check — new hire Nikhil's start date is 6/1 but his OPT ends 5/15 and H-1B transfer is in progress. We need to coordinate benefits effective date and a travel letter. :thinking:
Nikhil Kumar: hi! can I travel internationally between 5/16 and 6/1 if the H-1B petition is still pending? I have a family thing.
Anna (ImmCounsel): short answer: not recommended if H-1B change of status is pending. Leaving the US could abandon COS; you might need consular processing. If you must travel, we need to discuss timing and risk.
Priya Agarwal: thanks Anna. For staffing/planning, can we set a provisional start date that accounts for visa risk? e.g., remote onboarding until paper finalized?
Sasha (People Ops): yes — we can set start as 6/1 with remote-first onboarding. Benefits and payroll can be backdated only if employment is active — needs confirmation from payroll. @Elliot can you advise on benefits eligibility window?
Elliot (Finance): Benefits enrollment window for new hires is 30 days from start. If start remains 6/1 we can enroll 6/1 effective date. If we need earlier coverage due to gap, we'd need exception approval (rare). Share docs and I can request exception.
Nikhil Kumar: understood. If I can't travel, can I still do remote onboarding from outside the US while on OPT? (I know OPT has rules)
Anna (ImmCounsel): generally OPT requires F-1 status and there are travel complexities. Recommend staying in the US during OPT if possible. If you leave after OPT expires, re-entry is risky. We'll schedule a call to walk through scenarios.
Sasha (People Ops): action items: 1) Anna to send a brief risk summary and draft employment verification letter for consulate if needed. 2) Nikhil to confirm travel dates. 3) People Ops to provision remote onboarding checklist and benefits timeline.
Anna (ImmCounsel): drafting letter now. Draft snippet below you can reuse for consulate — feel free to tweak:
```
To Whom It May Concern,
This letter confirms that Nikhil Kumar has an offer of employment with Redwood Inference beginning 1 June 2026. Position: Software Engineer. Annual salary: $XXX,XXX. Redwood will sponsor/has filed an H-1B petition (receipt no. 13-XXXXXX) with requested start date of 6/1/2026. Please contact immigration@redwood.com for verification.
```
Sasha (People Ops): perfect — I'll attach that to the onboarding packet.
Nikhil Kumar: thanks — I can delay travel to after 6/15 if that reduces risk. Will confirm by EOD. :relieved:
Elliot (Finance): if start shifts earlier than 6/1 we need an approved exception for benefits. Otherwise enroll 6/1 automatically.
immigration-bot: Reminder: schedule 15-min consult with Anna at https://calendly.com/immcounsel/15 — helps finalize travel decision.
Priya Agarwal: re: team planning — I'll prepare ramp tasks for remote-first week and mark calendar tentative until Nikhil confirms. :thumbsup:
Sasha (People Ops): thanks everyone — I'll update the offer packet and HRIS. Nikhil ping me once travel dates are final and we'll proceed.
